_doc: Canonical media verbs (SPEC §7G). Ports embed this table verbatim: verb order, tool names, descriptions, normalised args, types and required flags are byte-contract. A tool's schema lists only the args its style maps, in this order; required = this list's required ∩ mapped.

verbs.description: Generate an image from a text prompt.
Generate a short video from a prompt, optionally starting from an image URL. Can take minutes.

args.name: prompt
args.description: What should happen in the video.

verbs.description: Speak text aloud and return the audio.
Transcribe speech in an audio URL to text.
Create a cloned voice from audio sample URLs and return its voice id.

args.name: samples
args.description: URLs of audio samples of the voice.

verbs.description: Make the person in an image speak the given audio (lip-synced video).
